2026_02_MIN_CHI.headline: Wentz takes Minnesota into a Soldier Field pressure duel with Chicago’s surging offense
2026_02_MIN_CHI.paragraph1: Minnesota will start Carson Wentz with Kyler Murray ruled out in concussion protocol, and the Vikings also lack Jauan Jennings. Chicago enters healthy after its explosive opener, making Brian Flores’ aggressive pressure plan central to the matchup. Caleb Williams must diagnose blitzes and late rotations without giving Minnesota short fields, while Wentz needs protection and help from the run game to avoid predictable passing downs. Wet conditions could further reward whichever offense stays efficient early and protects possession.
2026_02_MIN_CHI.model_rationale: Chicago’s answers against Minnesota’s pressure and Wentz’s ability to protect possession without a full supporting cast should determine which offense avoids the most damaging negative plays.
